children: UK computing platform maker's H1 revenue rose 90% yr/yr to record high
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 more than doubled, up 108% yr/yr
Company benefited from strategic memory inventory purchases amid industry supply constraints
Company expects second-half unit volumes to exceed first-half levels
Raspberry Pi expects full-year EBITDA to be ahead of market consensus
Company says it has sufficient memory inventory to meet FY 2026 production goals
STRONG OEM DEMAND - Co said accelerating adoption by OEM customers and robust reseller channel demand drove unit shipment growth
STRATEGIC MEMORY INVENTORY - Co benefited from consumption of memory inventory acquired at lower prices in FY 2025, supporting product availability and profitability amid supply-chain disruption
HIGHER SELLING PRICES - Co implemented substantial price increases on boards to offset higher memory component costs, boosting average selling price and gross profit per board
